# Moorland Loop

Day ride, 68 km over the moor from home and back, with 1,100 m of climbing.

Rain from the start. Coffee stop at The Kettle in Brackenford, which does a very good flapjack. A bolt fell out of the bottle cage on the cattle grid descent, so the second bottle rode in my jersey pocket the rest of the way.

The long drag up Hob Hill is 6 km and never steep, a good place to practise steady pacing. Home by 2 pm, soaked.
